subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - next steps (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmeanalytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing: next steps (Acme Analytics)

Hi Alex / Priya

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today great conversation and appreciate the detail on expected usage patterns. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

Summary of what you shared
- Primary workloads: multi-turn summarization + conversational search
- Expected steady traffic: ~60 req/s, peak burst to ~120 req/s
- Typical prompt + response size: ~150 tokens total (avg)
- Latency target: p95 under 250ms for tail-sensitive UX
- Security: VPC peering + SOC2 compliance required, data residency US-West

Goal for the next call
- Dedicated capacity sizing / technical deep dive with our SE to map throughput -> instance/GPU profile, batching, and caching strategies. We'll also confirm fallback plan and rollout cadence for Dedicated.

Can you confirm availability for a 60 60 minute sizing call (we'd like to include our SE, Vivek):
- Tue Jul 6: 10:00 6:00 PT
- Wed Jul 7: 13:00 14:00 PT (preferred)
- Thu Jul 8: 16:00 17:00 PT

I've attached a short capacity-sizing template (capacity-sizing-template.pdf) if you can drop rough QPS / token distribution / sample payloads there before the call, it'll help us model configurations faster.

If Jul 7 1pm PT works, we'll lock in a 60-min deep dive and bring a preliminary mapping of GPU types and estimated cost ranges.

Thanks talk soon.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

A couple of clarifying items before the call:
- Our p95 latency target is critical for the front-end UX if you can include options that prioritize tail latency over throughput that'd be great.
- We have a hard requirement for US-West data residency.
- We'll share an anonymized sample payload and 1 week of traffic traces ahead of time.

Attaching the S3 folder in the calendar invite is fine looking forward to the deep dive.

- Initial GPU mapping for 7B quant and 13B fp16 models (rough instance counts and expected p95 token latency)
